scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.vercel:build: PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/gridora run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build:vercel && rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && OUT=$(find . -type f -path '*/dist/public/index.html' -print -quit) && test -n "$OUT" && cp -R "${OUT%/index.html}/." public/
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.build:hostinger: PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/gridora run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
